drive/fivebar_workspace.zh: 工作空间：网格各点中 IK 可解且 FK∘IK 在 tol 内回到原处的点(只把在分支 out/forward 上不矛盾的点视为"可达")。返回值 ``{"xs","ys","mask","area","x_max","x_min"}``(x_max = 可达的最前方 x)。
drive/fivebar_workspace.tw: 工作空間：網格各點中 IK 可解且 FK∘IK 在 tol 內回到原處的點(只把在分支 out/forward 上不矛盾的點視為「可達」)。回傳值 ``{"xs","ys","mask","area","x_max","x_min"}``(x_max = 可達的最前方 x)。
drive/fivebar_workspace.ko: 작업 영역: 격자의 각 점에서 IK가 풀리고 FK∘IK가 tol 이내로 돌아오는 곳(가지 out/forward에서 모순되지 않는 곳만 "닿음"으로 봄). 반환값 ``{"xs","ys","mask","area","x_max","x_min"}``(x_max = 닿는 가장 앞쪽의 x).
drive/fivebar_workspace.de: Arbeitsraum: die Gitterpunkte, an denen IK lösbar ist und FK∘IK innerhalb von tol zurückkehrt (nur auf dem Zweig out/forward widerspruchsfreie Punkte gelten als "erreichbar"). Rückgabewert ``{"xs","ys","mask","area","x_max","x_min"}`` (x_max = das am weitesten vorn erreichbare x).
drive/fivebar_workspace.hi: workspace: grid के वे बिंदु जहाँ IK हल होता है और FK∘IK tol के भीतर लौटता है (केवल branch out/forward पर सुसंगत बिंदु "पहुँच योग्य" माने जाते हैं)। return value ``{"xs","ys","mask","area","x_max","x_min"}`` (x_max = पहुँच योग्य सबसे आगे का x)।

drive/fivebar_reach_interval.en: The reachable y interval on the defense line x = x_line (on a grid, with an FK∘IK round trip). ``{"y_lo","y_hi","ok"}``.
drive/fivebar_reach_interval.zh: 防守线 x = x_line 上可达的 y 区间(按网格，含 FK∘IK 往返)。``{"y_lo","y_hi","ok"}``。
drive/fivebar_reach_interval.tw: 防守線 x = x_line 上可達的 y 區間(按網格，含 FK∘IK 往返)。``{"y_lo","y_hi","ok"}``。
drive/fivebar_reach_interval.ko: 수비선 x = x_line 위에서 닿는 y 구간(격자로, FK∘IK 왕복 포함). ``{"y_lo","y_hi","ok"}``.
drive/fivebar_reach_interval.de: Erreichbares y-Intervall auf der Verteidigungslinie x = x_line (auf einem Gitter, mit FK∘IK-Hin-und-Rückweg). ``{"y_lo","y_hi","ok"}``.
drive/fivebar_reach_interval.hi: defence line x = x_line पर पहुँच योग्य y का अंतराल (grid पर, FK∘IK round trip के साथ)। ``{"y_lo","y_hi","ok"}``।

drive/striker_plan.en: Strike planning (rule-based): computes the joint angles for the predicted crossing point by IK and moves each servo at a constant angular velocity ≤ ω_max. Required time = max|Δq|/ω_max. Feasible if it gets there before the arrival at the crossing point. Return value ``{"feasible","reason","q_target","dq","t_move","t_arrive","t_cross","E"}``, reason ∈ {"ok","no_crossing","unreachable","too_late"}. ``crossing`` = return value of :func:`puck_crossing_point` (None allowed). The default ω_max = 6 rad/s is an assumption.
drive/striker_plan.zh: 击球规划(基于规则)：对预测的交点用 IK 求关节角，各伺服以恒定角速度 ≤ ω_max 运动。所需时间 = max|Δq|/ω_max。若在到达交点之前就位则为 feasible。返回值 ``{"feasible","reason","q_target","dq","t_move","t_arrive","t_cross","E"}``，reason ∈ {"ok","no_crossing","unreachable","too_late"}。``crossing`` = :func:`puck_crossing_point` 的返回值(可为 None)。ω_max = 6 rad/s 的默认值为假定。
drive/striker_plan.tw: 擊球規劃(基於規則)：對預測的交點以 IK 求關節角，各伺服以恆定角速度 ≤ ω_max 運動。所需時間 = max|Δq|/ω_max。若在抵達交點之前就位則為 feasible。回傳值 ``{"feasible","reason","q_target","dq","t_move","t_arrive","t_cross","E"}``，reason ∈ {"ok","no_crossing","unreachable","too_late"}。``crossing`` = :func:`puck_crossing_point` 的回傳值(可為 None)。ω_max = 6 rad/s 的預設值為假定。
drive/striker_plan.ko: 타점 계획(규칙 기반): 예측한 교점에 대해 IK로 관절각을 구하고, 각 서보를 일정 각속도 ≤ ω_max로 움직입니다. 소요 시간 = max|Δq|/ω_max. 교점 도착보다 먼저 도달하면 feasible. 반환값 ``{"feasible","reason","q_target","dq","t_move","t_arrive","t_cross","E"}``, reason ∈ {"ok","no_crossing","unreachable","too_late"}. ``crossing`` = :func:`puck_crossing_point`의 반환값(None 가능). ω_max = 6 rad/s의 기본값은 가정입니다.
drive/striker_plan.de: Schlagplanung (regelbasiert): berechnet per IK die Gelenkwinkel für den vorhergesagten Kreuzungspunkt und bewegt jeden Servo mit konstanter Winkelgeschwindigkeit ≤ ω_max. Benötigte Zeit = max|Δq|/ω_max. Feasible, wenn er vor der Ankunft am Kreuzungspunkt dort ist. Rückgabewert ``{"feasible","reason","q_target","dq","t_move","t_arrive","t_cross","E"}``, reason ∈ {"ok","no_crossing","unreachable","too_late"}. ``crossing`` = Rückgabewert von :func:`puck_crossing_point` (None zulässig). Der Standardwert ω_max = 6 rad/s ist eine Annahme.
drive/striker_plan.hi: strike planning (rule-based): अनुमानित crossing बिंदु के लिए IK से joint कोण निकालता है और हर servo को स्थिर angular velocity ≤ ω_max से चलाता है। आवश्यक समय = max|Δq|/ω_max। crossing बिंदु पर puck के आने से पहले पहुँचे तो feasible। return value ``{"feasible","reason","q_target","dq","t_move","t_arrive","t_cross","E"}``, reason ∈ {"ok","no_crossing","unreachable","too_late"}। ``crossing`` = :func:`puck_crossing_point` की return value (None भी चलता है)। default ω_max = 6 rad/s एक मान्यता है।

drive/fivebar_trajectory.en: Joint trajectory q(t) of the plan: constant angular velocity from t_now over t_move, then stops on arrival. (N,2).
drive/fivebar_trajectory.zh: 规划的关节轨迹 q(t)：从 t_now 起 t_move 期间以恒定角速度运动，到达后停止。(N,2)。
drive/fivebar_trajectory.tw: 規劃的關節軌跡 q(t)：從 t_now 起 t_move 期間以恆定角速度運動，抵達後停止。(N,2)。
drive/fivebar_trajectory.ko: 계획의 관절 궤적 q(t): t_now부터 t_move 동안은 일정 각속도, 도착하면 멈춥니다. (N,2).
drive/fivebar_trajectory.de: Gelenktrajektorie q(t) des Plans: ab t_now während t_move konstante Winkelgeschwindigkeit, nach der Ankunft Stillstand. (N,2).
drive/fivebar_trajectory.hi: plan की joint trajectory q(t): t_now से t_move तक स्थिर angular velocity, पहुँचने पर रुकना। (N,2)।

drive/puck_scene_mjcf.en: Self-made minimal MJCF (Coulomb version, mujoco not required): a cylindrical puck (free joint) on a plane with friction, 4 walls (boxes), an overhead camera. The Challenge table uses viscous damping, so use this one to check Coulomb uniform deceleration in MuJoCo. Wall restitution comes from soft contact, so e is measured.
drive/puck_scene_mjcf.zh: 自制的最小 MJCF(Coulomb 版，不需要 mujoco)：有摩擦的平面上的圆柱冰球(自由关节)、4 面壁(箱体)、正上方相机。Challenge 的球台是黏性阻尼，因此要在 MuJoCo 中验证 Coulomb 匀减速请用这个。壁的反弹为软接触，e 需测量。
drive/puck_scene_mjcf.tw: 自製的最小 MJCF(Coulomb 版，不需要 mujoco)：有摩擦的平面上的圓柱球餅(自由關節)、4 面壁(箱體)、正上方相機。Challenge 的球桌是黏性阻尼，因此要在 MuJoCo 中驗證 Coulomb 等減速請用這個。壁的反彈為軟接觸，e 需量測。
drive/puck_scene_mjcf.ko: 자체 제작한 최소 MJCF(Coulomb 버전, mujoco 불필요): 마찰이 있는 평면 위의 원기둥 퍽(자유 관절), 4장의 벽(박스), 바로 위 카메라. Challenge의 테이블은 점성 감쇠이므로, Coulomb 등감속을 MuJoCo에서 확인하려면 이쪽을 씁니다. 벽의 반발은 연접촉이므로 e는 측정합니다.
drive/puck_scene_mjcf.de: Selbst erstelltes minimales MJCF (Coulomb-Version, mujoco nicht erforderlich): ein zylindrischer Puck (freies Gelenk) auf einer Ebene mit Reibung, 4 Wände (Boxen), eine Kamera von oben. Der Tisch der Challenge nutzt viskose Dämpfung, daher dieses Modell verwenden, um die gleichmäßige Coulomb-Verzögerung in MuJoCo zu prüfen. Der Wandabprall entsteht durch weichen Kontakt, daher wird e gemessen.
drive/puck_scene_mjcf.hi: अपना न्यूनतम MJCF (Coulomb रूप, mujoco आवश्यक नहीं): friction वाले plane पर cylinder puck (free joint), 4 दीवारें (boxes), ठीक ऊपर camera। Challenge की table viscous damping वाली है, इसलिए MuJoCo में Coulomb uniform deceleration की जाँच के लिए इसका उपयोग करें। दीवार का restitution soft contact से आता है, इसलिए e मापा जाता है।

drive/insertion_failure_table.en: Failure classification table (data): each row = {``cls``, ``when`` (field → set of allowed values, ``"*"`` = anything), ``recovery``, ``basis``}.
drive/insertion_failure_table.zh: 失败分类表(数据)：每行 = {``cls``, ``when``(字段 → 允许值的集合，``"*"`` = 任意), ``recovery``, ``basis``}。
drive/insertion_failure_table.tw: 失敗分類表(資料)：每列 = {``cls``, ``when``(欄位 → 允許值的集合，``"*"`` = 任意), ``recovery``, ``basis``}。
drive/insertion_failure_table.ko: 실패 분류표(데이터): 각 행 = {``cls``, ``when``(칸 → 허용 값의 집합, ``"*"`` = 무엇이든), ``recovery``, ``basis``}.
drive/insertion_failure_table.de: Fehlerklassifikationstabelle (Daten): jede Zeile = {``cls``, ``when`` (Feld → Menge erlaubter Werte, ``"*"`` = beliebig), ``recovery``, ``basis``}.
drive/insertion_failure_table.hi: failure classification table (data): हर row = {``cls``, ``when`` (field → अनुमत मानों का set, ``"*"`` = कुछ भी), ``recovery``, ``basis``}।

drive/insertion_failure_validate.en: Validates the table (fail-closed): spelling of the field vocabulary, class names and recovery names; **pairwise exclusivity** (no 2 rows can match the same signature = there is no pair of rows whose allowed sets intersect in every field); **reachability** (≥ 1 row for every class other than unknown).
drive/insertion_failure_validate.zh: 校验表(fail-closed)：字段词汇、类名、恢复名的拼写，**所有对的互斥**(不存在 2 行可能命中同一签名 = 没有在所有字段上允许集合都相交的行对)，**可达性**(unknown 以外的所有类都有 ≥ 1 行)。
drive/insertion_failure_validate.tw: 驗證表(fail-closed)：欄位詞彙、類別名稱、恢復名稱的拼寫，**所有配對的互斥**(不存在 2 列可能命中同一簽名 = 沒有在所有欄位上允許集合都相交的列對)，**可達性**(unknown 以外的所有類別都有 ≥ 1 列)。
drive/insertion_failure_validate.ko: 표를 검증합니다(fail-closed): 칸의 어휘·클래스 이름·회복 이름의 철자, **모든 쌍의 배타성**(2행이 같은 서명에 해당할 수 없는지 = 모든 칸에서 허용 집합이 교차하는 행 쌍이 없음), **도달성**(unknown 이외의 모든 클래스에 ≥ 1행).
drive/insertion_failure_validate.de: Prüft die Tabelle (fail-closed): Schreibweise von Feldvokabular, Klassennamen und Recovery-Namen; **paarweise Exklusivität** (keine 2 Zeilen können auf dieselbe Signatur passen = es gibt kein Zeilenpaar, dessen erlaubte Mengen sich in allen Feldern schneiden); **Erreichbarkeit** (≥ 1 Zeile für jede Klasse außer unknown).
drive/insertion_failure_validate.hi: table को validate करता है (fail-closed): field शब्दावली, class नामों और recovery नामों की spelling, **सभी जोड़ों की exclusivity** (क्या 2 rows एक ही signature पर लागू हो सकती हैं = ऐसी rows का कोई जोड़ा नहीं जिनके अनुमत sets हर field में मिलते हों), **reachability** (unknown के अलावा हर class के लिए ≥ 1 row)।

drive/insertion_signature.en: Discretizes continuous observations into a signature in the table's vocabulary.
drive/insertion_signature.zh: 将连续的观测离散化为表词汇的签名。
drive/insertion_signature.tw: 將連續的觀測離散化為表詞彙的簽名。
drive/insertion_signature.ko: 연속 관측을 표의 어휘로 된 서명으로 이산화합니다.
drive/insertion_signature.de: Diskretisiert kontinuierliche Beobachtungen zu einer Signatur im Vokabular der Tabelle.
drive/insertion_signature.hi: लगातार observations को table की शब्दावली वाले signature में discretise करता है।

drive/insertion_failure_classify.en: Looks up a signature in the table (fail-closed): if exactly 1 row matches, its class and recovery; if 0, ``"unknown"`` (no guessing); if 2 or more, ``ValueError`` as a table defect (cannot happen with a table that passed :func:`insertion_failure_validate`).
drive/insertion_failure_classify.zh: 用表查签名(fail-closed)：命中 1 行则返回其类与恢复，0 行则为 ``"unknown"``(不做推测)，2 行以上则视为表的缺陷抛出 ``ValueError``(通过 :func:`insertion_failure_validate` 的表不会发生)。
drive/insertion_failure_classify.tw: 以表查簽名(fail-closed)：命中 1 列則回傳其類別與恢復，0 列則為 ``"unknown"``(不做推測)，2 列以上則視為表的缺陷拋出 ``ValueError``(通過 :func:`insertion_failure_validate` 的表不會發生)。
drive/insertion_failure_classify.ko: 서명을 표에서 찾습니다(fail-closed): 해당 행이 1개면 그 클래스와 회복, 0개면 ``"unknown"``(추측하지 않음), 2개 이상이면 표의 결함으로 ``ValueError``(:func:`insertion_failure_validate`를 통과한 표에서는 일어나지 않음).
drive/insertion_failure_classify.de: Schlägt eine Signatur in der Tabelle nach (fail-closed): passt genau 1 Zeile, deren Klasse und Recovery; bei 0 ``"unknown"`` (kein Raten); bei 2 oder mehr ``ValueError`` als Defekt der Tabelle (kann bei einer Tabelle, die :func:`insertion_failure_validate` bestanden hat, nicht auftreten).
drive/insertion_failure_classify.hi: signature को table में खोजता है (fail-closed): ठीक 1 row मिले तो उसकी class और recovery, 0 मिलें तो ``"unknown"`` (अनुमान नहीं लगाता), 2 या अधिक मिलें तो table का दोष मानकर ``ValueError`` (:func:`insertion_failure_validate` से पास हुई table में ऐसा नहीं होता)।

drive/insertion_recovery_primitive.en: Table of recovery primitives (class → description of the motion). ``name`` is a ``recovery`` word of the table.
drive/insertion_recovery_primitive.zh: 恢复原语表(类 → 动作的描述)。``name`` 是表中 ``recovery`` 的词。
drive/insertion_recovery_primitive.tw: 恢復基元表(類別 → 動作的描述)。``name`` 是表中 ``recovery`` 的詞。
drive/insertion_recovery_primitive.ko: 회복 프리미티브의 표(클래스 → 동작의 기술). ``name``은 표의 ``recovery`` 단어입니다.
drive/insertion_recovery_primitive.de: Tabelle der Recovery-Primitive (Klasse → Beschreibung der Bewegung). ``name`` ist ein ``recovery``-Wort der Tabelle.
drive/insertion_recovery_primitive.hi: recovery primitives की table (class → गति का विवरण)। ``name`` table का ``recovery`` शब्द है।

drive/jamming_parallelogram_planar.en: Derives the jamming parallelogram **from the planar statics of two-point contact** (a 2nd path checked against the vertices of pegsim.jamming_diagram = the values of OCW p.34).
drive/jamming_parallelogram_planar.zh: **由两点接触的平面静力学推导**卡死(jamming)平行四边形(与 pegsim.jamming_diagram 的顶点 = OCW p.34 的值相互核对的第 2 路径)。
drive/jamming_parallelogram_planar.tw: **由兩點接觸的平面靜力學推導**卡死(jamming)平行四邊形(與 pegsim.jamming_diagram 的頂點 = OCW p.34 的值相互核對的第 2 路徑)。
drive/jamming_parallelogram_planar.ko: 재밍(jamming)의 평행사변형을 **2점 접촉의 평면 정역학으로부터 유도합니다**(pegsim.jamming_diagram의 정점 = OCW p.34의 값과 대조하는 2번째 경로).
drive/jamming_parallelogram_planar.de: Leitet das Jamming-Parallelogramm **aus der ebenen Statik des Zweipunktkontakts her** (ein 2. Weg, abgeglichen mit den Eckpunkten von pegsim.jamming_diagram = den Werten aus OCW p.34).
drive/jamming_parallelogram_planar.hi: jamming parallelogram को **two-point contact की planar statics से व्युत्पन्न** करता है (pegsim.jamming_diagram के शीर्षों = OCW p.34 के मानों से मिलाने वाला 2nd रास्ता)।

drive/jamming_force_check.en: Whether the measured tip force ratios (F_x/F_z, M/(rF_z)) lie inside Whitney's parallelogram (wraps pegsim.jamming_diagram and adds which edge is nearest and which slanted edge applies to the current contact configuration).
drive/jamming_force_check.zh: 测得的末端力之比 (F_x/F_z, M/(rF_z)) 是否位于 Whitney 平行四边形内部(封装 pegsim.jamming_diagram，并补充最接近哪条边、哪条斜边对当前接触配置起作用)。
drive/jamming_force_check.tw: 量測到的末端力之比 (F_x/F_z, M/(rF_z)) 是否位於 Whitney 平行四邊形內部(封裝 pegsim.jamming_diagram，並補充最接近哪條邊、哪條斜邊對目前接觸配置起作用)。
drive/jamming_force_check.ko: 측정한 선단 힘의 비 (F_x/F_z, M/(rF_z))가 Whitney 평행사변형 안쪽에 있는지 판정합니다(pegsim.jamming_diagram을 감싸고, 어느 변에 가까운지와 어느 빗변이 현재 접촉 배치에 작용하는지를 더합니다).
drive/jamming_force_check.de: Ob die gemessenen Kraftverhältnisse an der Spitze (F_x/F_z, M/(rF_z)) innerhalb von Whitneys Parallelogramm liegen (umhüllt pegsim.jamming_diagram und ergänzt, welcher Kante sie am nächsten liegen und welche Schrägkante für die aktuelle Kontaktkonfiguration maßgeblich ist).
drive/jamming_force_check.hi: मापे गए सिरे के बल-अनुपात (F_x/F_z, M/(rF_z)) Whitney के parallelogram के अंदर हैं या नहीं (pegsim.jamming_diagram को wrap करता है, और कौन सा किनारा सबसे पास है तथा कौन सा तिरछा किनारा वर्तमान contact configuration पर लागू होता है, यह जोड़ता है)।

drive/wedging_risk.en: Wedging risk for tilt θ [rad]: the ratio θ/(c/μ) to the boundary c/μ (OCW p.28) and 3 levels (``safe`` / ``near`` / ``over``) that take the margin ``margin_deg`` into account. Wraps pegsim.wedging_check and adds ``theta_limit_deg`` and ``headroom_deg`` = c/μ − θ in degrees. At μ = 0 the boundary is inf and the result is always safe. **Raises** ``ValueError``: θ < 0, margin_deg < 0.
drive/wedging_risk.zh: 倾角 θ [rad] 的楔住风险：相对边界 c/μ(OCW p.28)的比值 θ/(c/μ)，以及考虑余量 ``margin_deg`` 的 3 级(``safe`` / ``near`` / ``over``)。封装 pegsim.wedging_check，并以度为单位补充 ``theta_limit_deg``、``headroom_deg`` = c/μ − θ。μ = 0 时边界为 inf，始终为 safe。**Raises** ``ValueError``：θ < 0、margin_deg < 0。
drive/wedging_risk.tw: 傾角 θ [rad] 的楔住風險：相對邊界 c/μ(OCW p.28)的比值 θ/(c/μ)，以及考慮餘裕 ``margin_deg`` 的 3 級(``safe`` / ``near`` / ``over``)。封裝 pegsim.wedging_check，並以度為單位補充 ``theta_limit_deg``、``headroom_deg`` = c/μ − θ。μ = 0 時邊界為 inf，恆為 safe。**Raises** ``ValueError``：θ < 0、margin_deg < 0。
drive/wedging_risk.ko: 기울기 θ [rad]의 쐐기(wedging) 위험도: 경계 c/μ(OCW p.28)에 대한 비 θ/(c/μ)와, 여유 ``margin_deg``를 고려한 3단계(``safe`` / ``near`` / ``over``). pegsim.wedging_check를 감싸고 ``theta_limit_deg``와 ``headroom_deg`` = c/μ − θ를 도 단위로 더합니다. μ = 0에서는 경계가 inf이므로 항상 safe입니다. **Raises** ``ValueError``: θ < 0, margin_deg < 0.
drive/wedging_risk.de: Verkeilungsrisiko bei Neigung θ [rad]: das Verhältnis θ/(c/μ) zur Grenze c/μ (OCW p.28) und 3 Stufen (``safe`` / ``near`` / ``over``) unter Berücksichtigung der Reserve ``margin_deg``. Umhüllt pegsim.wedging_check und ergänzt ``theta_limit_deg`` und ``headroom_deg`` = c/μ − θ in Grad. Bei μ = 0 ist die Grenze inf und das Ergebnis stets safe. **Raises** ``ValueError``: θ < 0, margin_deg < 0.
drive/wedging_risk.hi: tilt θ [rad] पर wedging का जोखिम: सीमा c/μ (OCW p.28) के सापेक्ष अनुपात θ/(c/μ) और margin ``margin_deg`` को ध्यान में रखकर 3 स्तर (``safe`` / ``near`` / ``over``)। pegsim.wedging_check को wrap करता है और ``theta_limit_deg`` तथा ``headroom_deg`` = c/μ − θ degrees में जोड़ता है। μ = 0 पर सीमा inf है और हमेशा safe। **Raises** ``ValueError``: θ < 0, margin_deg < 0।

drive/insertion_stall_detect.en: Detects stalls from a depth time series [m] (at each tick i, stalled if depth[i] − depth[i − window] < min_advance).
drive/insertion_stall_detect.zh: 从深度时间序列 [m] 检测停滞(在每个时间步 i，若 depth[i] − depth[i − window] < min_advance 则为 stalled)。
drive/insertion_stall_detect.tw: 從深度時間序列 [m] 偵測停滯(在每個時間步 i，若 depth[i] − depth[i − window] < min_advance 則為 stalled)。
drive/insertion_stall_detect.ko: 깊이 시계열 [m]에서 정체를 검출합니다(각 틱 i에서 depth[i] − depth[i − window] < min_advance이면 stalled).
drive/insertion_stall_detect.de: Erkennt Stillstände aus einer Tiefen-Zeitreihe [m] (in jedem Tick i stalled, wenn depth[i] − depth[i − window] < min_advance).
